data.desc: PGIM is the global asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. ( NYSE: PRU ), with $1.5 trillion in assets under management.1 PGIM offers clients deep expertise across public and private asset classes, delivering a diverse range of investment strategies and tailored solutions - including fixed income, equities, real estate and alternatives. With 1,500+ investment professionals across 40 offices in 20 countries, we serve retail and institutional clients worldwide.
